graph_models_and_cypher: One FalkorDB graph per tenant (hound:alpha, hound:beta) plus hound:consortium. Domain: Party(:Person|:Company, :Customer, :Sanctioned), Account(:External), Branch, Device, IP, Phone, Email, Address, Jurisdiction, Alert; edges HOLDS, TRANSFER{amount,ts,channel,memo}, CASH_DEPOSIT{amount,ts,ctr}, USES, LOGGED_IN_FROM, HAS_PHONE, HAS_EMAIL, LIVES_AT, REGISTERED_AT, OWNS{pct}, DIRECTOR_OF, IN_JURISDICTION, ON. Agent/provenance layer: Case, AgentRun, Evidence(cypher,params,data), Finding, SAR, Lesson, Playbook/Step with SUBJECT, CONCERNS, FROM_ALERT, HAS_EVIDENCE, PRODUCED, INVOLVES, HAS_FINDING, SUPPORTED_BY, CITES, WORKED_ON, HANDOFF, ABOUT, REFINES, LEARNED_FROM, STEP. Cypher is parameterized and extensive (UNWIND frontier, pattern comprehensions, reduce, UNION, OPTIONAL MATCH, ro_query). Uses FalkorDB-native algo.pageRank/betweenness/labelPropagation/WCC (no APOC/GDS). COMPATIBILITY: upstream docs/FALKORDB_NOTES.md says the project pins FalkorDB 6.0.2 and that on 4.22.1 the shape 'WITH coalesce(p, a) AS n ... MATCH (c)-[:R]->(n)' raised '_AR_EXP_UpdateEntityIdx'; the same shape is used in tools._resolve_account and closely related coalesce-alias shapes in tools._resolve_party and memory.recall/add_lesson/record_evidence, so these may need rewriting for Kairos's 4.22 server (not tested here). Notes also record a 6.0.1 UNWIND+varlen WHERE bug and a collect() bug.

Cypher is generated by f-string with label/relationship names checked against allow-lists and _NAME regex, and values inlined via custom _cypher_value/qid escaping (not query parameters): CREATE via UNWIND [{...literal rows...}] AS row; reads such as MATCH (c)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(t {id: '<escaped id>'}) RETURN DISTINCT c.id. Hop-limited BFS is done in Python over repeated one-hop queries rather than variable-length Cypher. No Neo4j GDS/APOC and no FalkorDB algo.* procedures.

graph_models_and_cypher: Two layers in FalkorDB (16 node labels / 16 relationship types per architecture.md and backend/schema.py): Layer 1 inventory/posture (Workload, ServiceAccount, RBACRole, Service, Ingress, EntryPoint, CrownJewel, IAMRole, WorkerNode, ... with CAN_REACH_NET, USES_SA, BOUND_TO, MOUNTS_HOST, ASSUMES_IAM_ROLE, REQUIRED_DEPENDENCY, ALLOWS_API, EXPOSES, ROUTES_TO, SELECTS) and Layer 2 :EXPLOIT_STEP edges {step_type, technique, mechanism, cost} between :VirtualSource and :VirtualSink. Cypher uses $params; mutation Cypher is stored per candidate (MATCH ... DELETE r). Uses FalkorDB-specific algo.SPpaths({sourceNode,targetNode,relTypes}) and GRAPH.COPY for sandboxes; query() uses ro_query for reads. find_shortest_paths builds the MATCH label/property names via f-string from keyword arguments with defaults (values are params). compose.yaml uses falkordb/falkordb:latest (unpinned). NOTE: LastLift's docs (docs/falkordb-sppaths-note.md) report algo.SPpaths on FalkorDB 4.22.0 running for hours and ignoring query timeout on dense graphs, so Fjord's reliance on it is a risk on Kairos' 4.22 server.
